onboarding_welcome_subtitle: Accessible communication and safety tools for Deaf and hard-of-hearing people
onboarding_welcome_desc: SilentHelp brings emergency check-ins, trusted support, nearby places, digital safety guidance, and communication tools together in one app.
onboarding_sos_subtitle: Get help when you need it most
onboarding_sos_step1: Open Emergency for SOS or an I am safe / I need help check-in
onboarding_sos_step2: Choose which saved trusted contacts receive your check-in SMS
onboarding_sos_step3: Time and available location may be included; location depends on permission and device signal
onboarding_profile_step1: Open Profile to add or update your personal details
onboarding_profile_step2: Add trusted people so you can choose who receives check-ins
onboarding_profile_step3: Create your digital ID card with medical info
onboarding_language_subtitle: You can change this anytime in Settings
onboarding_language_desc: Select your preferred language to use the app
onboarding_phrases_subtitle: Use Talk mode, quick phrases, and sign lessons
onboarding_phrases_desc: Choose a tool that works for you. Quick phrases help with common situations; Talk mode supports typed and spoken conversation.
onboarding_circle_subtitle: Plan who can support you and find nearby services
onboarding_circle_step1: Add trusted people such as family, a teacher, mentor, or clinic contact in Profile
onboarding_circle_step2: Review your Trusted Circle and choose contacts for safety check-ins
onboarding_circle_step3: Use Places to look for nearby clinics, hospitals, police, or other safe spaces
onboarding_digital_subtitle: Get practical guidance and think through your next steps
onboarding_digital_step1: Digital Safety offers offline tips about privacy, harassment, and online abuse
onboarding_digital_step2: A guided report can be reviewed and sent by SMS to a trusted contact you choose; it is not an official report
onboarding_digital_step3: Save a personal safety plan on this device; it is not encrypted and does not send alerts automatically

digital_home_subtitle: Privacy tips and a guided abuse report
digital_safety_intro: Practical steps for online safety. This guidance is stored in the app and works offline.
digital_protect_body: Use a screen lock and strong, unique passwords. Turn on two-step verification when available, and never share verification codes.
digital_privacy_body: Limit who can see your profile, posts, location, and contact details. Check these settings again after app updates.
digital_harassment_body: You do not have to reply. If safe, block and report the account, and tell someone you trust. Avoid confronting a person who may put you at risk.
digital_image_body: Do not forward intimate or abusive images. Save account names, links, dates, and messages only if it is safe. Ask a trusted adult or support service for help.
digital_pause_body: Check the original source, date, and context. Be cautious with urgent claims, edited media, and requests to share personal information.
digital_emergency_note: If you are in immediate danger, use Emergency or contact local emergency services. This app does not send reports to authorities.

report_evidence_note: Do not attach or forward intimate images. The app does not store evidence or send your location with this report.

safety_plan_home_subtitle: Plan who to contact and where to go
safety_plan_intro: Think through a few steps before you need them. Saving a plan does not contact anyone or share your location.
safety_plan_privacy_warning: This plan is saved on this device without encryption. If someone else can unlock or access this phone, they may see it. Avoid sensitive details on a shared device.
